foreignObject.div:
anticipation: sink, turn the sword side back
98ms

raise: blade over the head, shield arm reaches forward
98ms

top of the raise: back arched, sword foot leaves the ground
112ms

step lands: hips whip round first, blade still up
57ms

the cut: shoulders follow the hips, arm snaps down
46ms

impact (hit-stop): knees give, weight on the front foot
103ms

follow-through: blade carried low across the body
92ms

hold: stays down for a breath
184ms

step back: the front foot comes back
81ms
